reviews.t: The better ones, Soapwalla (my previous favorite)
reviews.x: Over the past year and a half, I've been searching for a non-commercial deodorant that would work for me. Due to formulation changes over the past 10-15 years, it has gotten to a point where I can only use around 3 different commercial deodorants that do not cause chemical burns to my pits with long use. I've used many other popular and not so popular alternatives and haven't found that "perfect" product yet.  The better ones, Soapwalla (my previous favorite), Piper Kai, and Primal Pit P

reviews.t: Great product for anyone who wants a natural deodorant product

reviews.t: Despite advertising it for sensitive skin and baking soda free it still cause rash and irritation
reviews.x: Really wanted to like this product and make it work as it was one of the only baking soda free products like this, however it was underwhelming for me. I found it to not reduce or prevent excess sweating , it did nothing to mask sweat smell or keep me dry and despite it not having baking soda I still had some major irritation. Perhaps this will work for you if you do not workout or sweat , and if you do no have sensitive pits; but its probably just going to go in my trash bin and call it a loss

I had almost given up the hope of finding a deodorant that didn't cause my skin to break out or that would last for more than a few hours.  This deodorant went beyond my expectations.  I ordered the smallest size the first time as a test.  I still have quite a bit left, but I ordered again in the larger size — just in case, for some reason, it gets discontinued…..like some of the best things seem to do.  It has a nice fresh smell.  I think you won't be disappointed.

This deo works for me for about a week, but then I start to get a built-up stench. I'm not sure if the beeswax clogs my pores or what, but I have to do about a week using this then a few days off for the odor to disappear. I also started to get a rash after about 3 months of use, which wasn't great. I have stopped using it.  I still gave it three stars because it did work for a while okay. It smells pretty good and is easy to use.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product for being gentle on sensitive skin and free of baking soda irritation, though a few still report rashes or irritation.
Several reviewers say it effectively controls odor and holds up well, including through workouts and marathons, but some report it fails during stress sweat, intense workouts, or within the day.
Reviewers frequently describe the scent as pleasant, light, or neutral, while a few find it unimpressive or overpowering.
Some reviewers are dissatisfied with the small size of the product.
A few reviewers note the product leaves skin smoother or goes on easily.
